privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Aethora is a fantasy fitness RPG. This policy describes the information used to provide the app.
privacy.section1: When you sign in, Supabase Authentication handles your account. Aethora may store game progress, including level, XP, streaks, quest and workout completion, and related settings in the connected Supabase data store.
privacy.section2: Activity and workout details that you enter are used to calculate game progress and rewards. The current web app does not connect to Apple Health, Google Fit, or Health Connect.
privacy.section3: The app displays advertisements through Monetag where enabled. The ad provider may process information under its own privacy policy, including device or advertising identifiers where permitted.
privacy.section4: We use information to authenticate you, save progress, operate quests and rewards, provide requested features, and maintain app security.
privacy.section5: We do not publish your private account information. Data may be processed by Supabase and Monetag to provide their services, or disclosed when required by law. Retention depends on account and service needs.
privacy.section6: You may stop using the app or request account-data assistance through the app publisher. Device and browser controls may also limit advertising technologies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Aethora, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
terms.section1: Aethora provides fantasy-themed fitness quests, workouts, progression, streaks, rewards, reminders, and related entertainment features.
terms.section2: Aethora is not medical advice, a medical device, or a substitute for professional care. Choose activities appropriate for you and stop if you feel unwell.
terms.section3: Keep account credentials secure and provide accurate information. Do not abuse, reverse engineer, disrupt, or attempt unauthorized access to the service or its rewards.
terms.section4: Features may change, pause, or become unavailable. Progress can be affected by device, network, authentication, or service failures. We may update these terms as the app evolves.
terms.section5: Advertisements may appear through Monetag. Aethora is not responsible for third-party services or external content. To the extent permitted by law, use the app at your own risk.

ageOfCreation.title: The Age of Creation
ageOfCreation.content: In the beginning, Aethora was shaped by the Great Weavers — immortal beings of starlight and song. They carved kingdoms from mountains, rivers from tears of joy, and forests from their own breath. The first mortals emerged from the sacred soil of Valerion, blessed with the spark of potential.

firstEmpire.title: The First Empire
firstEmpire.content: For a thousand years, the Empire of Golden Light united the realm under one banner. Its capital stood where Valerion now rises. The empire's fall came not from war, but from forgetting — the rulers lost touch with the land and its people, and the weavers' magic faded into legend.

greatWeaving.title: The Great Weaving
greatWeaving.content: When the weavers departed, they left behind threads of power woven into the land itself. These threads became the ley lines that connect Aethora's sacred places. The Silverpine Forest guards the oldest of these threads — a weaver's loom frozen in time beneath its roots.

blightEra.title: The Era of Blight
blightEra.content: After the empire fell, a corrosive darkness seeped from the ruins of Eldridge. The Blight twisted forests, poisoned waters, and turned friends to foes. It was the Age of Ash — a time when survival mattered more than glory, and legends were made by those who refused to yield.

reclamation.title: The Age of Reclamation
reclamation.content: From the ashes rose new kingdoms. Valerion reclaimed its throne. Dawnshire became a haven for those who sought peace. The Shattered Waste slowly healed under the watch of brave souls willing to venture into the corruption. Today, Aethora enters a new era — one where mortals shape their own destiny.

orderOfEternity.title: Order of Eternity
orderOfEternity.content: The Order of Eternity guards the northern passes and the ancient secrets of Frosthold. Their knights take vows of silence and service, believing that some truths are too powerful for words. They seek the Heart of Aethora — the mythical source of all ley line energy.

wanderersGuild.title: Wanderers' Guild
wanderersGuild.content: Founded in Dawnshire, the Wanderers' Guild helps travelers navigate Aethora's roads and mysteries. Their members range from simple guides to legendary explorers who have mapped the farthest reaches of the realm. The guild's symbol — a compass rose entwined with a vine — represents their belief that every journey leads to growth.

embercourt.title: Embercourt
embercourt.content: Deep in Emberwood, the Embercourt faction tends the eternal flame that keeps the blight at bay. Their warriors, called Ash Wardens, undergo trials of fire to prove their worth. They believe that destruction and creation are two sides of the same coin — that to build something new, one must first clear away what is old.

observatory.title: The Observatory
observatory.content: Perched on the Windscar Cliffs, the Observatory is the highest point in Aethora. Ancient astronomers used it to track the movements of celestial bodies and predict magical tides. The Observatory's star charts are said to reveal not just the position of stars, but the position of destiny itself.

silentTower.title: The Silent Tower
silentTower.content: In the heart of Eldridge stands a tower that makes no sound. Birds do not nest there. Wind does not whistle through its windows. Those who enter report hearing whispers from their own past — voices they thought forgotten. The Silent Tower is Eldridge's greatest mystery, and some say it holds the key to understanding the blight itself.

heartStone.title: The Heart Stone
heartStone.content: At the center of the realm, hidden beneath Frosthold, lies the Heart Stone — a crystal the size of a mountain that pulses with the rhythm of Aethora itself. It is the source of all magical energy in the realm, and the reason why some places feel alive with power. Legends say that whoever holds the Heart Stone can reshape the world, but the responsibility is too great for any one mortal.

kingOfValerion.title: The King of Valerion
kingOfValerion.content: The King rules from the Golden Palace in Valerion, the crown jewel of Aethora. His lineage stretches back to the First Empire, and his wisdom is sought by rulers across the realm. Yet he carries a burden — the knowledge that one day, the Heart Stone will call for a new guardian, and the king must be ready to pass the torch.

adventurerOrigins.title: The Adventurer's Path
adventurerOrigins.content: Every great hero begins as a wanderer. Dawnshire's rolling hills and peaceful villages foster those who dream of more than a quiet life. The Adventurer's Path teaches that courage is not the absence of fear, but the decision that something else is more important than fear.

scholarResearch.title: Scholar's Research
scholarResearch.content: In the libraries of Silverpine Forest, scholars study the ancient texts left by the weavers. They seek to understand the magic that flows through Aethora — not to control it, but to cooperate with it. The scholar's role is to preserve knowledge and ensure that each generation builds upon the last.

sageWisdom.title: Sage's Wisdom
sageWisdom.content: The Sage of Windscar Cliffs has watched over Aethora for centuries, accumulating wisdom like others accumulate wealth. The sage's teachings emphasize patience, observation, and the understanding that the greatest power comes from knowing when not to act. In the sage's tower, a single candle has burned for a hundred years — proof that small things can illuminate great darkness.

heroDestiny.title: The Hero's Destiny
heroDestiny.content: Legend speaks of a hero who will one day unite the realm — not through conquest, but through example. This hero will show that strength and kindness are not opposites, that discipline and compassion can coexist. The hero's destiny is not written in stone, but forged anew by each choice made in the service of others.

hakariOrigin.title: Hakari's Origin
hakariOrigin.content: Hakari emerged from the ember ashes of Emberwood as a spark of pure potential. Not quite mortal, not quite spirit — Hakari exists in the space between, bringing joy and encouragement wherever the path grows steep. The Embercourt sees Hakari as a sign that the eternal flame still burns bright.

miriOrigin.title: Miri's Origin
miriOrigin.content: Miri came from the silver threads of the ancient loom beneath Silverpine Forest — a manifestation of the weavers' creativity. Miri represents the playful, curious side of magic: the belief that wonder is not childish, but essential. Where Hakari brings courage, Miri brings delight.
